input: Assess the credit and counterparty risk of Beyond Meat

financials.metric: Cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash (stated liquidity)
Total outstanding carrying value of debt, net of debt discount
Net cash used in operating activities

debt_events.summary: Closed up to $100 million of new senior secured delayed-draw term-loan financing from Unprocessed Foods, LLC, an Ahimsa Foundation affiliate. Drawn amounts accrue PIK interest at 12.0% before the initial 2030 maturity and 17.5% afterward; the facility also includes warrants for up to 12.5% of currently outstanding shares.

Entered privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of the 2027 Notes, exchanging $15.0 million aggregate principal for approximately 1.55 million common shares. The company reported $14.5 million aggregate principal of 2027 Notes remaining as of 2026-09-26, maturing 2027-03-15.

payment_behaviour.summary: Creditsafe data reported by Food Dive showed days beyond terms rising from 8 days in August 2024 to 19 days in July 2025, above the 12-day industry average; about half of outstanding bills were 1–30 days past due in July 2025 versus roughly one-third in September 2024. Creditsafe characterized the trend as indicating possible liquidity pressure.

Beyond Meat told Food Dive it had not filed and was not planning to file for bankruptcy; this was a company denial in response to media reports, not evidence that supplier-payment concerns had been resolved.

distress_signals.summary: Third-quarter 2026 revenue fell 8.1% year over year to $64.529 million and volume fell 10.9%; the company reported a $92.960 million operating loss and guided fourth-quarter revenue to approximately $54–59 million.

The quarter included $57.097 million of non-cash long-lived-asset impairment charges and $20.832 million of non-cash accelerated rent expense tied to a partial Campus Headquarters lease termination; the company also reported a $24.556 million Adjusted EBITDA loss.
Food Dive reported that Beyond Meat planned to cut 6% of its workforce and had named an interim chief transformation officer for turnaround and restructuring efforts.

ownership.value: Public company; founder-led by Ethan Brown, who is the founder, President and CEO.

output.risk_rationale: High counterparty risk: as of 2026-09-26, reported debt of $313.9 million exceeded cash and restricted cash of $169.3 million, while the latest quarter showed a $92.960 million operating loss, a $24.556 million Adjusted EBITDA loss and $37.258 million of nine-month operating cash burn. The company has a $14.5 million 2027 Notes maturity on 2027-03-15, has relied on debt exchanges and a high-cost senior secured financing, and external trade-credit data reported materially slower supplier payments; impairment charges, lease restructuring, layoffs and continuing revenue declines add execution and liquidity risk.
missing_fields: verified supplier collection suits or late-payment judgments
